verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no capability for a user to schedule recurring jobs or workflows on IRS services. The items cover one-off filings (EIN assistant, MeF, IRIS A2A), ID.me sign-in walls, and payment pages listed by title only (Direct Pay, EFTPS, Payment Plan), with no documented recurring-schedule feature. Recurring scheduling of payments or filings is a plausible capability for tax-service rails, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
